kitr.title: Tauri kit
kitr.summary: Start the app kit in a Tauri shell with typed Rust commands and events from the same React app.

kit.audience: Teams shipping a desktop app where download size matters more than identical rendering everywhere.

highlights.title: The dashboard in Tauri
highlights.text: A small native app that uses the system webview.

highlights.title: Typed Rust commands
highlights.text: `app/commands.ts` calls the commands in `src-tauri/src/lib.rs`, with types on both sides.

highlights.title: Events from Rust
highlights.text: Rust emits events with `app.emit`, and the page listens with `useTauriEvent`.

highlights.title: A Rust project to grow
highlights.text: `platforms/app/src-tauri/` is a normal Cargo project with its capabilities file.
